title: 4x4 mesh, 16-node TP BROADCAST (root fanout, source rank 7), 1024 B payload

expected.notes: PW2 audit: BROADCAST from a NON-trivial root (7, not participants[0]). Oracle laws: messages = k-1 = 15, only rank 7 sends, one B-byte message to every other rank, aggregate = (k-1)B. A lowering that silently uses participants[0] fails only-root-sends.
